description: Strata models offered by tools/bootstrap.ps1. Source: https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/blob/main/docs/MODELS.md (2026-10). rank = estimated capability for coding/agent work in this project (1 = smartest); memGB = RAM+VRAM the model needs; downloadGB = first download; tier = GPU/memory load (see tiers). Ids are checked with `strata launch --plan` before anything is downloaded. Edit freely when Strata adds models.

tiers.超高: VRAM+RAM 100GB 以上、または SSD から読みながら動く（ワークステーション級）
tiers.低: VRAM+RAM 40GB 未満（RAM 32〜48GB + GPU 12GB 程度）
